Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is dangerous at the blade tip. Watch the cast animation and dodge outside its tip range or move inside it. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits, leave its area immediately; if you risk being pulled back, use the Camille E Hookshot you saved. When Aatrox R World Ender is active, his healing increases, so stop the duel and create distance.
Aatrox.build: Aatrox deals mostly physical damage, so buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor. Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen then helps in side lane duels alongside the physical shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses. If duels often run long, consider healing reduction after building resistances.
Aatrox.fight: Trade just after Aatrox uses the empowered basic attack from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance on a minion. Basic attack an enemy champion to trigger the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, and space out the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. Dodge the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade while hitting with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep to heal.
Aatrox.laning: For the first two levels, focus on CS and dodge the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade instead of forcing an early engage. Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, but do not force an engage with Camille E Hookshot if Aatrox is behind minions or far from a wall. Avoid trades while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are unavailable so you do not give up an early kill.
Aatrox.combo: When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down and you have an angle on a wall, use Camille E Hookshot to attach to it while casting Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Aatrox.escape: Right after you force Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your window to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, save Camille E Hookshot to escape the pull. Delay your engage while Aatrox R World Ender is active, then close in again after it expires.
Aatrox.phase: Camille is weak in the first two levels, while Aatrox can turn an early lead into a large advantage. Focus on CS and do not give up a kill. Camille becomes strong in the mid game with two core items, so look for side lane duels and chances to join your jungler.
Aatrox.teamfight: Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. Watch your entry timing so Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade or Aatrox W Infernal Chains does not catch you first. If the teamfight setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw an enemy over.

Akali.watch: Once the mark lands, the second dash follows Camille as she escapes.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance first against Akali's main damage. If a single burst is the problem, use Banshee's Veil to block the opening ability.
Akali.fight: On your engage, catch her with the slow from the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep or the stun from Camille E Hookshot.
Akali.laning: Play safely for the first two levels, focus on CS, and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Avoid trades while Camille E Hookshot or Camille P Adaptive Defenses is unavailable.
Akali.combo: If Akali is far away, engage by stunning her first with Camille E Hookshot.
Akali.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. If Akali E Shuriken Flip is also down, especially before Akali R Perfect Execution is available again, close the gap with Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Akali.phase: Camille is strongest in the mid game with two core items, so fight while Akali's ultimate is unavailable.
Akali.teamfight: Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to isolate one enemy. If you target Akali, close in with Camille E Hookshot after Akali W Twilight Shroud and her other ways to move are unavailable. If you would have to engage alone, push a side lane turret to draw an enemy over.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when it returns, and its return damage increases with the amount of missing health. If you are cursed, move out of the straight line between you and Aurora; if your health is low, back off before it returns. Leaving the area after Aurora R Between Worlds appears slows you, so get out before it forms or find an angle to fight inside it.
Aurora.build: Aurora deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance alongside the magic shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses. Choose Ionian Boots of Lucidity for ability haste. If a single opening ability is the problem, consider Banshee's Veil.
Aurora.fight: Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then look to engage after Aurora uses a movement ability. Once in range, basic attack first to trigger the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then space out the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits and leaves you low on health, do not force the trade to continue.
Aurora.laning: Prioritize farming for the first two levels and manage your health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. If Aurora stands behind minions far from a wall, do not force an engage with Camille E Hookshot. After using Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses, avoid trades until they are ready again.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora's movement ability is down and there is an opening for a kill, slow her with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then trap her with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Aurora.escape: Do not engage as soon as Aurora W Across the Veil goes down; check Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora R Between Worlds too. When Aurora uses a movement ability to engage, especially before Aurora R Between Worlds is available again, you have a chance to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If Aurora uses Aurora W Across the Veil to become invisible, wait briefly and use your abilities when she reappears.
Aurora.phase: Camille is weakest in the first two levels, so focus on farming and managing your health early.
Aurora.teamfight: If Aurora leaps in and does not participate in a kill, catch her with your team while her movement ability is down. If an ally is killed, the cooldown of Aurora W Across the Veil may reset, so do not leave a low health ally behind when retreating. Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers; if the setup is poor, draw an enemy to a side lane.

Fiora.build: Build armor first and buy Plated Steelcaps early against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Then consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. Armor cannot block the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge, so if duels run long, buy healing reduction after building resistances.
Fiora.fight: Stand on the side opposite the Vital revealed by Fiora and briefly counterattack when she dashes in with Fiora Q Lunge. Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then basic attack to trigger the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses and space out the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. If Fiora W Riposte is available, do not open with the stun from Camille E Hookshot.
Fiora.laning: For the first two levels, focus on CS and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep instead of forcing an early engage. Watch which side Fiora's vital appears on and stand on the opposite side to limit her angle. Do not chase after a short trade. Avoid fighting while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are unavailable.
Fiora.combo: After drawing out Fiora W Riposte, slow her with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then collide with her using Camille E Hookshot to stun her.
Fiora.escape: Right after you force Fiora Q Lunge is a chance to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If Fiora W Riposte is down, there is less risk of her blocking your Camille E Hookshot stun and stunning you instead.
Fiora.phase: Camille is weak in the first two levels, so focus on farming and short trades early. After learning your ultimate, look for chances to join your jungler and follow up on ganks, then use your strength in the mid game with two core items.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stand against a wall so she cannot strike all four vitals. Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. If the setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw an enemy over.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and immobilizing effects. If she blocks Camille E Hookshot’s stun, she can stun Camille. While Riposte is available, don’t rush into a collision with E. When she uses it, move sideways to avoid the counterstrike. If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, hug a wall to block one side’s vital.

Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he can follow with an auto attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside its range. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move beyond the blade or get close to him to reduce his healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance. If health has decreased while those stacks remain, get completely out of Darius R Noxian Guillotine range.
Darius.build: Most of Darius's damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor with Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. Darius E Apprehend has armor penetration and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so armor alone will not let you survive his ultimate.
Darius.fight: Take short trades after Darius E Apprehend is down, retreating after striking. Break off the fight if Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up.
Darius.laning: Camille is weak for her first two levels, so focus on CS and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep early. Trade when Darius uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions or misses Darius E Apprehend. Do not fight again while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are down.
Darius.combo: Once Darius E Apprehend is down, slow him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then auto attack to trigger the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses. If you have a good angle from a wall, land the stun from Camille E Hookshot to buy time for the second hit of Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Darius.escape: Engage with Camille E Hookshot when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. Right after Darius uses Darius Q Decimate to clear minions is another chance to poke.
Darius.phase: Avoid forcing early trades: Camille is weak for her first two levels, while Darius is strong in early skirmishes. Camille is strongest in the mid game with two core items, so use short trades to create an advantage.
Darius.teamfight: Follow your team's engage with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. If several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage have accumulated and health has decreased, leave Darius R Noxian Guillotine range to avoid being killed and giving him another cast. If the teamfight setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits only the first target and deals damage based on current health, so be especially careful at high health and stand behind minions. Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so do not rely on the stun from Camille E Hookshot to engage while his passive is up. While Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, account for his healing and increased movement speed rather than forcing a kill.
DrMundo.build: Dr. Mundo's main damage comes from the physical damage of Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma, so build armor first. Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw and Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper deal magic damage, so armor alone will not protect you. If duels run long, get healing reduction after building resistances.
DrMundo.fight: Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep from a position where minions can block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw. When trading, auto attack first to trigger the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, since Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma can deal physical damage to you.
DrMundo.laning: Camille is weak for her first two levels, so focus on CS and manage your health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep instead of forcing an engage. Do not force an engage with Camille E Hookshot if Dr. Mundo is far from a wall and standing behind minions. After a trade, step on the canister Dr. Mundo drops to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction. Avoid fighting while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are down.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is up, it will ignore the stun from Camille E Hookshot. Wait until his passive is down before engaging.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so look to close in with Camille E Hookshot when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down and you have a good wall angle. Keep minions between you and Dr. Mundo to avoid the slow from Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw while setting up the engage. If Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, do not force a kill; look for a dive or force an objective while it is down.
DrMundo.phase: Camille has weak base stats and wave clear for her first two levels, so prioritize farming. She then becomes able to trade with Camille Q Precision Protocol and Camille P Adaptive Defenses. After learning her ultimate, look to join your jungler and follow up on ganks.
DrMundo.teamfight: Target someone else instead of spending time trying to kill Dr. Mundo while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active. Follow your team's engage onto an enemy main damage dealer and trap them with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum to give your team time to finish them. If the teamfight setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Chogath.watch: When the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears under your feet, move sideways and save Camille E Hookshot for that moment. Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences targets in front of him, making the following Cho'Gath Q Rupture harder to dodge, so avoid fighting directly in front of him. Even behind minions, stay out of the straight path of Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. If you are at half health or lower, retreat beyond the range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.
Chogath.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Cho'Gath Q Rupture, Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes. Choose Ionian Boots of Lucidity. If burst damage is a problem, consider Banshee's Veil first; if crowd control lasts too long, consider Quicksilver Sash first.
Chogath.fight: After dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture, auto attack to trigger the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses and trade with Camille Q Precision Protocol. Leave time between its two hits and weave in auto attacks. Take a step back to land the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and heal. Avoid the front of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and use Camille E Hookshot when an engage angle opens up.
Chogath.laning: Camille is weak for her first two levels, so focus on CS and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep rather than forcing an early engage. Stand off the line of Cho'Gath's auto attacks so Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes does not hit you along with the minions. Right after Cho'Gath uses Cho'Gath Q Rupture on the wave, pressure him or follow up on a jungle gank to slow his early growth.
Chogath.escape: A missed Cho'Gath Q Rupture, or one just used on the wave, is your chance to engage with Camille E Hookshot. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you, walk out of its area first instead of trying to cast abilities. Cho'Gath has no mobility ability, so once you dodge his crowd control and close in, hold him with the stun from Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Chogath.phase: Camille is weak for her first two levels, but Cho'Gath grows stronger over time. Farm safely early and pressure him when Cho'Gath Q Rupture is down. Camille is strongest in the mid game with two core items, so look for fights and chances to join your jungler then.
Chogath.teamfight: Approach with Camille E Hookshot as your team engages, then trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If you go in alone first, you can easily die after reaching just one target, so engage when your team can finish them. If the setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Gangplank.watch: If Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed, avoid its explosion by destroying the keg from outside its range. Do not step where two kegs overlap.
Gangplank.build: Build armor early and buy Plated Steelcaps sooner against the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg.
Gangplank.fight: Look to trade just after Gangplank places Gangplank E Powder Keg or immediately after you destroy a nearby keg. Back away if a primed keg is close. When fighting up close, auto attack Gangplank to trigger the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then leave time between the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is up, he can clear the stun from Camille E Hookshot, so watch whether he uses it before engaging.
Gangplank.laning: For the first two levels, focus on CS rather than forcing an early engage, and poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Keep your distance if Gangplank E Powder Keg is primed. If he has just placed a new keg and you have a wall angle, try to trade. After using Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses, avoid trading until they are ready again.
Gangplank.combo: When Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down and Gangplank E Powder Keg is not primed, use Camille E Hookshot to attach to a wall and cast Camille W Tactical Sweep while moving. Before trapping him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, pin him down with the stun from Camille E Hookshot or the slow from Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so engage when Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down and a nearby Gangplank E Powder Keg is not primed. Close the gap with Camille E Hookshot and aim for the stun, then hold him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Gangplank.phase: Camille is weakest for her first two levels, so endure poke from Gangplank Q Parrrley and focus on CS early. Look to trade when Camille Q Precision Protocol and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are ready. After learning her ultimate, focus on joining your jungler and following up on ganks.
Gangplank.teamfight: Watch whether Gangplank has used Gangplank R Cannon Barrage when choosing when to fight for objectives. In teamfights, follow your team's engage with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers and give your team time to finish them. If the setup for engaging together is poor, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Garen.watch: If Garen Q Decisive Strike is active, engaging first makes it hard to fight back through the silence. When Garen E Judgment starts spinning, leave its range instead of staying in the fight. Right after Garen W Courage, delay the stun from Camille E Hookshot slightly because he has a shield and tenacity. If you are below half health, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.
Garen.build: Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment deal mostly physical damage, so buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor. Consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen afterward. Garen E Judgment reduces armor and Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage, so do not rely on armor to fight for too long or stay when low on health.
Garen.fight: Take a short trade right after Garen uses his empowered Garen Q Decisive Strike attack on a minion or it has otherwise been spent. Hit an enemy champion with a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then space out the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. Back away while Garen E Judgment is spinning, and do not rush the stun from Camille E Hookshot right after he activates Garen W Courage.
Garen.laning: Camille has weak base stats and wave clear for the first two levels, so focus on CS instead of forcing an early engage. Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and draw Garen toward a position where you can use a wall. Farm if there is no opening to engage.
Garen.combo: After Garen's empowered Garen Q Decisive Strike attack is spent, hit him with a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses.
Garen.escape: Garen has no ability to create distance on his own, so once his empowered Garen Q Decisive Strike attack is spent, you have an opening to engage with Camille E Hookshot. If he has just activated Garen W Courage, wait briefly before engaging so the stun is not blunted. While Garen E Judgment is spinning, move out of its range and keep the trade short.
Garen.phase: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so focus on CS and avoid forced fights. Garen grows stronger as he stacks Garen W Courage, so limit his chances to scale early. Later, pressure a side lane to draw opponents away instead of facing them head-on.
Garen.teamfight: Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers and give your team time to finish them off. Time your engage with your team's rather than going in alone first. If the teamfight setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw opponents away.

Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss slows, and Mini Gnar's boomerang can also hit you on its return. Step out of its path, and avoid angles where Mega Gnar can knock you into a wall with Gnar R GNAR!.
Gnar.build: Gnar deals mostly physical damage, so buy Plated Steelcaps first and build armor with Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. Armor does not block the magic damage from Gnar W Hyper / Wallop, which also scales with maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Gnar.fight: Watch Gnar's Rage bar and start a fight right after he changes from Mega to Mini. Against Mini Gnar's poke, heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep while looking for an opening. When Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, close in with Camille E Hookshot.
Gnar.laning: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so do not force an early engage into Mini Gnar's ranged poke. If Gnar is far from a wall or standing behind minions, farm instead of using Camille E Hookshot. Avoid fights while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are down.
Gnar.combo: If Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, slow him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then use a wall to engage and stun him with Camille E Hookshot.
Gnar.escape: Right after you force out Gnar E Hop / Crunch, you have an opening to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. Right after Mega Gnar returns to Mini, he cannot transform again for a while; close in then and look for an all-in.
Gnar.phase: Camille is weak for the first two levels, and Mini Gnar can poke from range, so prioritize CS.
Gnar.teamfight: Beware of Mega Gnar's Gnar R GNAR! and avoid fights with your back to a wall or in narrow terrain. Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. If the setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw opponents away.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to reach you, so keep your distance when minions are close to dying. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped inside the blade wall from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear. Crossing it deals extra damage and applies a strong slow.
Irelia.fight: Hit Irelia with a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then take a short trade. Once her Irelia Q Bladesurge chain ends, look for a chance to close in with Camille E Hookshot.
Irelia.laning: Camille is also weak for the first two levels, so focus on CS instead of forcing an early engage. Do not leave a half-health minion between you and Irelia for her to dash through. Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Avoid trades while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are down.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia's Irelia Q Bladesurge chain ends, you have an opening to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot. If the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down, you can close in and trap her with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Irelia.phase: Camille is strongest in the mid game once she has two core items. After learning her ultimate, focus on joining your jungler and following up on ganks.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia because Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet have a major impact on teamfights. Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap her and give your team time to finish her off. If the setup makes it hard to go in alone first, push a side lane turret to draw opponents away.
Irelia.combo: Slow Irelia with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then aim to stun her on contact with Camille E Hookshot. Delay the second hit and, if possible, use a basic attack between the two hits.

Gwen.watch: The center of the cone from Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so sidestep it. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you cannot target Gwen from outside the mist; enter it or wait for it to end. Also watch out for the slow and maximum-health damage from Gwen R Needlework.
Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first against Gwen's main damage, and consider Spectre's Cowl. Armor also helps against the physical damage from her basic attacks. Resistances cannot block the true damage at the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!, and she also deals maximum-health damage, so focus on avoiding the center rather than just stacking health.
Gwen.fight: Before Gwen Q Snip Snip! reaches full stacks, poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. If Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down and Gwen W Hallowed Mist will not block you, engage with Camille E Hookshot.
Gwen.laning: Camille's base stats and wave clear are weak for the first two levels, so focus on CS and avoid forcing an early engage. Stay far enough away that Gwen cannot basic attack you, and chip away at her health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Gwen.combo: When Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down and Gwen W Hallowed Mist will not block you, slow her with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then stun her with Camille E Hookshot. If you have a kill opportunity, trap her with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum after the slow or stun.
Gwen.escape: Right after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is used, you have an opening to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash gets a large cooldown refund when it hits something, though, so that opening may be short around many minions. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, move into a position where you can target her or wait until the mist ends before engaging.
Gwen.teamfight: Time Camille E Hookshot with your team's engage to reach Gwen or another target you can pick off, then trap one enemy with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If you target Gwen, avoid positions where Gwen W Hallowed Mist prevents you from targeting her, and avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!. If the setup would require you to go in alone first, push a side lane turret to draw opponents away.

Illaoi.watch: Illaoi E Test of Spirit slows and marks you, so last-hit from outside its range to avoid it. Illaoi R Leap of Faith deals area damage and creates a tentacle for each champion hit, so do not group with allies when it lands; spread out when she casts it. Illaoi can heal with Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God near tentacles, so avoid prolonged fights there.
Illaoi.build: Illaoi deals mostly physical damage, so build Plated Steelcaps first and get armor. Consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen afterward. Account for Illaoi's healing by applying Grievous Wounds with Executioner's Calling before judging whether you can kill her.
Illaoi.fight: Fight right after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit and baiting out Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Start with a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Illaoi.laning: Early on, keep the wave away from walls and last-hit outside the range of Illaoi E Test of Spirit. Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, but save Camille E Hookshot until you have an opening to engage. After using Camille E Hookshot and the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, avoid trading until they are ready again.
Illaoi.combo: Right after Illaoi uses Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, slow her with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Then use Camille E Hookshot to attach to a wall and recast it to stun her.
Illaoi.escape: Your opening to engage comes right after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit and after she has also used Illaoi W Harsh Lesson. Close the gap with Camille E Hookshot, and use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum to stay on her if needed. If Illaoi R Leap of Faith is active, spread out during its damage window so she has no targets to fight.
Illaoi.phase: Camille is weakest at levels 1 and 2, so focus on CS and safe poke early instead of forcing the first engage.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy Illaoi's tentacles when you can; otherwise, draw her into open ground away from walls. Spread out against Illaoi R Leap of Faith and wait out its damage window. Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum as your allies engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers.

Jayce.watch: When Jayce places Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast may follow, so step sideways out of its straight path. When he has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate.
Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Magic resistance cannot block the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast, so get movement speed to leave its telegraphed attack area. Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Jayce.fight: Land a basic attack on Jayce to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then start the trade.
Jayce.laning: Farm defensively during Jayce's strong early game, especially at levels 1 and 2 when Camille is weak. Sidestep Jayce's straight-line attacks in cannon form while poking with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. If Jayce is behind minions far from a wall, or Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are unavailable, stop trading and farm.
Jayce.escape: Right after baiting out the hammer leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast is your chance to close the gap. Once the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate is also unavailable, engage with Camille E Hookshot and, if needed, trap Jayce with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, while Camille is especially weak at levels 1 and 2, so avoid forcing the first engage. Look for trades when Camille Q Precision Protocol and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are ready. Camille becomes stronger in the mid game with two core items.
Jayce.teamfight: Look for the moment after Jayce uses the hammer leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast and has no mobility ability available. Trap him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum as your allies engage, giving them time to finish him. If the engage is unfavorable, push a side-lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, it dodges basic attacks and Camille Q Precision Protocol, and its damage increases with each attack dodged. Move away from the stun radius of Jax E Counter Strike's recast, and save Camille E Hookshot because Jax can follow with Jax Q Leap Strike.
Jax.build: Jax's damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, so prioritize considering an item that reduces attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so build both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health.
Jax.fight: Once Jax E Counter Strike ends, poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. If Jax Q Leap Strike is also unavailable, close in with Camille E Hookshot and trade. Activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses with a basic attack, then leave time between the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in close-range trades at level 1, so do not force one. Chip away at his health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep while farming, and pressure him with your jungler while Jax E Counter Strike is unavailable. Stop trading while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are unavailable, and do not engage Jax when he is far from a wall or standing behind minions.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, slow him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then use Camille E Hookshot off a wall to stun him.
Jax.escape: Do not use Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum first just because Jax activates Jax E Counter Strike. Dodge its stun; right after Jax Q Leap Strike is used is your opening to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, do not group up; avoid its area stun. As soon as the stun ends, focus your crowd control with your allies to kill Jax. Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum as your allies engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers.

Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast reduces Camille's armor and magic resistance and slows her, so avoid a direct hit. When health has decreased, watch out for Kayle E Starfire Spellblade, which deals damage based on missing health. When Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, hold your damage and use the stun from Camille E Hookshot to wait out the invulnerability.
Kayle.build: Build magic resistance first against Kayle's main damage. Camille P Adaptive Defenses also grants a shield against Kayle's magic damage, so stacking magic resistance is efficient. Choose Ionian Boots of Lucidity for ability haste, and consider Banshee's Veil if burst damage is a problem.
Kayle.fight: Catch Kayle with the stun from Camille E Hookshot or the outer-edge slow from Camille W Tactical Sweep before she escapes with Kayle W Celestial Blessing.
Kayle.laning: If you have no angle for Camille E Hookshot off a wall, or Kayle is standing behind minions, farm and wait for an opening. After using Camille E Hookshot and the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, stop trading. When pressuring Kayle, go in with your jungler.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, so you can engage when a wall gives Camille E Hookshot an angle to reach her. Land the stun from Camille E Hookshot before she escapes with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. If she has already used Kayle R Divine Judgment, it is a good chance to engage again.
Kayle.phase: Camille is strong in the mid game with two core items, while Kayle grows stronger as the game goes on.
Kayle.teamfight: Find a path to Kayle from a flank or outside vision, and go in as your team engages. Trap Kayle with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, but hold your damage while Kayle R Divine Judgment is active. Wait out the invulnerability with the stun from Camille E Hookshot and your allies' crowd control, then focus Kayle.

Kled.watch: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, use Camille E Hookshot to create distance before it pulls you in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off to avoid taking the fourth basic attack, then reengage. If dismounted Kled's courage bar is nearly full, judge whether you can finish him before he remounts; if not, create distance.
Kled.build: Kled's main damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps first and build armor with Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. Camille P Adaptive Defenses will also grant a shield against physical damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and he deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Kled.fight: Avoid trading blows while taking all four attacks from Kled W Violent Tendencies. When Camille P Adaptive Defenses is ready, basic attack an enemy champion to activate the shield, then take a short trade with a delay between the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. Save Camille E Hookshot so you can escape the pull from Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope.
Kled.laning: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so collect CS without forcing the first engage. Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, and do not engage with Camille E Hookshot when Kled is far from a wall or behind minions. If you dismount him, push him away from the wave so he cannot build courage by killing minions.
Kled.combo: Hit with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep to heal and slow Kled. When you have a chance to kill him, catch him with that slow or the stun from Camille E Hookshot, then trap him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum and land the second Q.
Kled.escape: If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, escape with Camille E Hookshot before the pull triggers. Once both Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are down, use Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum to close the gap. If only Kled E Jousting is down, check his remaining mobility options before engaging.
Kled.phase: Camille is weak early, especially for the first two levels, so focus on denying Kled an advantage. Camille is strong in the mid game with two core items, while Kled falls off after the laning phase and mid game.
Kled.teamfight: Keep vision on the flanks to spot Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! coming from a distance. If you cannot stop the engage, position so your front line takes the hit first and your back line is not hit directly. As your team engages, trap one of their main damage dealers with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If the setup is poor, push a side-lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Malphite.watch: If Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits you, its slow makes it hard to engage or disengage, so do not start a trade immediately afterward. Malphite E Ground Slam reduces Camille's basic attack damage output, so use your Q combo after it is down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash with a knockup, so when he is out of sight, keep your distance from allies and deny him an engage angle.
Malphite.build: Build magic resistance first against Malphite's main damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, Malphite E Ground Slam, and Malphite R Unstoppable Force. Choose Ionian Boots of Lucidity for ability haste, and consider Banshee's Veil if burst damage is a problem.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then start a trade while you have not been hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard. Basic attack an enemy champion to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then leave time between the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. When Malphite E Ground Slam is down, you can close in and land basic attacks and your Q combo.
Malphite.laning: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so farm CS and avoid forcing an early engage. Break Malphite P Granite Shield with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and poke at short intervals. Save Camille E Hookshot until you have an angle from a wall.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, slow him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then basic attack an enemy champion to activate Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield. Once Malphite E Ground Slam is down and you have a wall angle, stun him with Camille E Hookshot to make time for two attacks.
Malphite.escape: Once Malphite E Ground Slam is also down, you have a window to land basic attacks and your Q combo. Malphite R Unstoppable Force cannot be interrupted with crowd control, so do not try to stop his dash with Camille E Hookshot.
Malphite.phase: In the late game, push a side-lane turret to draw an opponent out instead of forcing a direct fight.
Malphite.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force cannot knock up several of you at once, then counterattack as soon as it is down. Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum alongside your allies' engage to trap one enemy carry. If you would have to engage alone first, push a side lane turret to draw an opponent out instead.

Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement speed and attack speed, making it hard to land Camille's basic attacks and Camille Q Precision Protocol. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces your armor while you stand in it, so leave the area. Nasus becomes stronger while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; unless you have a clear numbers or damage advantage, avoid fighting until it ends.
Nasus.build: Nasus's main damage from Nasus Q Siphoning Strike is physical, so build armor first. Armor does not reduce the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire or Nasus R Fury of the Sands, but your priority is to avoid standing in Nasus E Spirit Fire. Nasus R Fury of the Sands deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about stacking only health.
Nasus.fight: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so do not force trades. Start applying early pressure when you can trade with Camille Q Precision Protocol and Camille P Adaptive Defenses. It is hard to keep basic attacking while affected by Nasus W Wither, so wait until it is down, poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then follow the stun from Camille E Hookshot with both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. Avoid fighting again until Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are ready.
Nasus.laning: Pressure Nasus early while he is building stacks by last hitting with Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Pushing the wave under his turret lets him stack safely, so let the wave come toward you and call for a jungle gank. If Nasus is far from a wall and behind minions, do not force an engage with Camille E Hookshot; farm CS instead.
Nasus.combo: Take a step back to hit with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and heal. To engage, attach to a wall with Camille E Hookshot, use Camille W Tactical Sweep during the leap, then follow the stun with both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Nasus.escape: Engage when Nasus W Wither is down and Nasus R Fury of the Sands is inactive. Nasus has no way to create distance other than Flash, so if you have an angle from a wall, catch him with Camille E Hookshot and trap him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. Do not go deep alone while affected by Nasus W Wither.
Nasus.phase: Camille is weak for the first two levels, but once Camille Q Precision Protocol and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are available, pressure Nasus early before he builds stacks. Camille is strongest in mid game with two core items.
Nasus.teamfight: When Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, do not fight him head-on. Keep your distance and wait it out. Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum alongside your allies' engage to isolate one enemy carry. If you cannot engage first on your own, push a side lane turret to draw an opponent out.

Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, so do not follow him toward his fallen axe. The stun from Camille E Hookshot does not work during Olaf R Ragnarok; keep your distance and engage after it ends. At low health, watch for the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, and sustain through it with the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses and the healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Olaf.build: Buy Plated Steelcaps first and build armor against Olaf's main physical damage. Then consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. Armor does not reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing, so build health too.
Olaf.fight: When Camille P Adaptive Defenses is ready, basic attack Olaf to activate the shield and take a short trade. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, do not stay in melee range. Create distance, then engage with Camille E Hookshot after it ends.
Olaf.laning: Early on, farm CS without giving Olaf a kill, and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Move in the opposite direction from where Olaf Q Undertow lands to make it harder for him to retrieve his axe and chase you. After using Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses, avoid trading until they are ready again.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, slow him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then use Camille E Hookshot to engage from a wall and land its collision stun.
Olaf.escape: If Olaf Q Undertow misses and lands where he cannot easily retrieve the axe, and Olaf R Ragnarok has ended, you have an opening to engage. Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so close in with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong early and Camille is weak for the first two levels, so avoid forcing a direct fight.
Olaf.teamfight: During Olaf R Ragnarok, do not rely on the stun from Camille E Hookshot to hold him in place. After his ultimate ends, use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum alongside your allies' engage to trap one enemy carry. If the engage angle is poor, push a side lane turret to draw an opponent out.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so stay outside its range. Keep minions between you and Pantheon to reduce poke from Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and do not attack him from the front during Pantheon E Aegis Assault. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.
Pantheon.build: Pantheon's main damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor. Then consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. Account for the armor penetration from Pantheon R Grand Starfall and the maximum health damage from Pantheon W Shield Vault; do not rely on stacking only armor or health.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid direct fights early. Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Once Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends, or if you get to his side, basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses before trading.
Pantheon.laning: Don’t trade with Pantheon during the first two levels. Farm from behind minions to reduce damage from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Manage your health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, and save Camille E Hookshot if you’re far from a wall or minions block your engage path. Avoid trading while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are down.
Pantheon.combo: After Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends, hit him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep to slow him, then trap him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If engaging from a wall, cast Camille W Tactical Sweep while moving with Camille E Hookshot, then follow the stun from the recast of Camille E Hookshot with a basic attack and Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Pantheon.escape: Look for an engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, when you are less likely to be interrupted by its stun. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also down and has not come back up, close the distance and catch him with Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Pantheon.phase: After learning her ultimate, Camille can look to join her jungler and follow up on ganks. She grows stronger in mid game once she has two core items.
Pantheon.teamfight: When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, leave its landing area first. Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your allies' engage to trap one enemy carry and give your team time to finish them off. If the engage angle is poor, push a side lane turret to draw an opponent out.

Ornn.watch: Near the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture or a wall, dodge toward open ground to avoid being knocked up by Ornn E Searing Charge's shockwave. If the final flame of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you Brittle, back away until it wears off. Also move out of the straight line between Ornn and the ram from Ornn R Call of the Forge God.
Ornn.build: Camille Q Precision Protocol gives you two empowered basic attacks, so consider a Spellblade item such as Trinity Force first. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so do not lean too heavily on one type of resistance. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on maximum health, so be wary of building only health.
Ornn.fight: Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Before a close trade, use a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses. When Ornn E Searing Charge or Ornn R Call of the Forge God is down, use a wall angle to stun him with Camille E Hookshot, then land both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Ornn.laning: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so focus on CS and chip away at Ornn with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep instead of forcing an early engage. Avoid the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture, and get close to interrupt Ornn if he tries to craft an item in lane. Avoid trading while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are down.
Ornn.combo: When you have a clear opening, stun with Camille E Hookshot, then follow with a basic attack and both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Ornn.escape: Do not engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down. The window to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum comes when Ornn R Call of the Forge God is also down, before it comes back up. If Ornn W Bellows Breath has made you Brittle, keep your distance first.
Ornn.phase: Ornn's damage is low early, but Camille is also weak for the first two levels, so avoid forcing fights and build a lead through poke and farming. Camille is strongest in the mid game with two core items; use that timing to join your jungler and apply pressure.
Ornn.teamfight: Dodge the ram from Ornn R Call of the Forge God sideways. Even after it passes, stay out of the straight line where Ornn can knock it back. Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum alongside your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. If the engage angle is poor, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Poppy.fight: Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then use a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses before trading. Engage with Camille E Hookshot after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down. Space out the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol to get the second hit's true damage.
Poppy.laning: For the first two levels, prioritize CS over forced trades and manage your health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Keep open ground behind you so Poppy E Heroic Charge cannot push you into a wall, and save Camille E Hookshot until an opening to engage appears. If you can safely step on the shield dropped by Poppy P Iron Ambassador first, deny her the shield.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends, use a basic attack to activate Camille P Adaptive Defenses and hit with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. When Poppy E Heroic Charge is down and you can reliably catch her, look for an angle to trap her with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Poppy.phase: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so focus on farming and poking with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep early. Once you have your ultimate, look to join your jungler and follow up on ganks. Make use of Camille's strength in the mid game when you have two core items.
Poppy.build: Build armor first to prepare for Poppy’s main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your max health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone. Don’t spend resources on magic resistance specifically to deal with Poppy.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy uses E Heroic Charge is your window to close the gap. Wait until Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then engage with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If Poppy is charging R Keeper’s Verdict, move out of her line of attack first.
Poppy.teamfight: Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum alongside your team's engage to isolate one of the enemy's main damage dealers. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, wait to engage with a dash; if you see Poppy charging R Keeper's Verdict, move out of her line of attack. If the engage looks bad, push turrets in a side lane to draw the enemy out.
Poppy.watch: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, dashing in with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum will be stopped, and you won’t be able to use movement abilities briefly. Stand in open space so Poppy E Heroic Charge can’t pin you against a wall and stun you. If you’re hit by Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the area before its second explosion. When Poppy charges R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of her line of attack.

Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, back out of basic attack range to avoid the empowered attack. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind minions, and do not force Camille E Hookshot while your vision is reduced. Quinn E Vault interrupts Camille's approach and creates distance, so avoid engaging first until Quinn has used it.
Quinn.build: Buy Plated Steelcaps first and build armor. Quinn's main damage is physical, so the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses also blocks physical damage. Consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen afterward.
Quinn.fight: Start a trade right after Quinn E Vault is down. Chip away at her health and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then use Camille E Hookshot to reach and stun her if you have a wall angle. Use a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, and space out the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Quinn.laning: For the first two levels, focus on CS and preserving health. Step back when Quinn P Harrier marks you. Dodge Quinn Q Blinding Assault from behind minions and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. If Quinn is far from a wall or standing behind minions, save Camille E Hookshot and farm.
Quinn.combo: When Quinn E Vault is down and you have a wall angle, use Camille E Hookshot to attach to the wall.
Quinn.escape: Right after Quinn E Vault is down is your window to engage. Close the gap with Camille E Hookshot, and if you have your ultimate, you can trap Quinn with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. Avoid trading while both Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are down.
Quinn.phase: Camille is weak for the first two levels and loses to Quinn's range early, so preserve your health and farm. Camille can trade when Camille Q Precision Protocol and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are ready, and grows strong in the mid game with two core items.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn comes in from the side, coordinate crowd control with your team to catch her. When you trap Quinn with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, time it with your team's engage so you can take her down together. Avoid going in alone first, focusing one target, and dying.

Renekton.watch: When Renekton's Fury from Renekton P Reign of Anger is near or above half, watch for an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. The empowered W breaks the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses before dealing damage, so stay out of Renekton W Ruthless Predator range at that point.
Renekton.build: The main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps early to build armor. Follow with Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. The second dash of empowered Renekton E Slice and Dice reduces armor, so position to dodge that dash too.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton has no Fury. Counterattack right after he has used Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Renekton.laning: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so focus on CS and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Adjust your position: standing in or behind the minion wave gives Renekton a way to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Avoid trading while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are down, and poke when Renekton steps forward to build Fury.
Renekton.combo: If Renekton's Fury is low and his mobility ability and stun are down, slow him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then trap him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. When engaging from a wall, attach to it with Camille E Hookshot, cast W while moving, then recast E to collide with and stun him.
Renekton.escape: Right after Renekton uses Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage is your window to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is also down and his Fury is low, engage and trade. If Renekton R Dominus is active, delay your engage and wait for it to expire.
Renekton.phase: In the late game, play a side lane to draw the enemy out.
Renekton.teamfight: Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. When Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum creates its area, it pushes other enemies away, giving your team time to take down the trapped target. If the setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Riven.watch: Watch out for Riven Q Broken Wings' successive dashes and third-hit knockup, and the stun from Riven W Ki Burst. Back off when you see her first dash. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, Riven's attack range and attack damage increase, so keep your distance until it ends. Be especially wary of its finishing attack when health has been reduced.
Riven.build: All of Riven's damage is physical, so build armor first. Get Plated Steelcaps early, then build Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. If Riven gets ahead, move your defensive items even earlier in your build.
Riven.fight: Trade after Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. If the fight starts at close range, use a basic attack first to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then allow time between the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. Right after Riven closes in, use the stun from Camille E Hookshot's collision to interrupt the rest of her combo.
Riven.laning: Avoid forcing an early engage in the first two levels. Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Save Camille E Hookshot and farm if Riven stands behind minions far from a wall. Avoid trading while Camille E Hookshot or Camille P Adaptive Defenses is unavailable.
Riven.combo: When Riven Q Broken Wings is on cooldown, slow her with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then use Camille E Hookshot to attach to a wall and look for a stun with the recast dash. If Riven's escape options are exhausted, Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum can trap her.
Riven.escape: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor are both mobility abilities, so do not rush in after only one is used. Look for a window before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back, especially after Riven W Ki Burst or the third hit of Riven Q Broken Wings has also been used. Then close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Riven.phase: Camille is weak in the first two levels, so focus on CS early and counterattack only when Riven Q Broken Wings is unavailable.
Riven.teamfight: Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. Do not go in alone first. If the engage angle is poor, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out. If Riven gets close, use the stun from Camille E Hookshot to interrupt the rest of her combo.

Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter deals damage based on maximum health, so limit how long you stay close to him. If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits, create distance or escape with Camille E Hookshot before the second shot. Getting hit by both increases the slow and reduces your magic resistance.
Rumble.build: Build an item with magic resistance first against Rumble's main damage. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on maximum health, so do not stack health alone.
Rumble.fight: Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then engage after the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield is gone. Back off when the trade ends to avoid taking Rumble Q Flamespitter for too long.
Rumble.laning: Camille is weak in the first two levels, so focus on CS and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep instead of forcing an early engage. If Rumble stands behind minions far from a wall, give up the Camille E Hookshot engage and farm. Avoid trading while Camille E Hookshot or Camille P Adaptive Defenses is unavailable.
Rumble.combo: Once the shield from Rumble W Scrap Shield is gone and you have an angle on a wall, attach to it with Camille E Hookshot and cast Camille W Tactical Sweep while moving.
Rumble.escape: If the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits, use a wall and Camille E Hookshot to escape before the second shot. When engaging, wait until the shield and movement speed boost from Rumble W Scrap Shield have ended. Rumble has no mobility ability, so if you have an angle on a wall, you can close in with Camille E Hookshot and trap him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Rumble.phase: Camille is weakest in the first two levels, so take CS instead of fighting Rumble for an extended time. She is strongest in the mid game with two core items; look for engage angles and chances to join your jungler then.
Rumble.teamfight: Approach your target with Camille E Hookshot or Camille W Tactical Sweep as your team engages. Trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum to give your team time to finish them off. If the teamfight setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker grows stronger right after Sett takes damage, so after dealing heavy damage, back off briefly and wait for his grit to decay. If it is difficult to dodge, move to the side of the targeting line to dodge the true damage in the center. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when there are enemies on both sides of Sett, so do not position yourself opposite a minion wave with Sett between you.
Sett.build: Build armor first against Sett's main damage and get Plated Steelcaps early. Then consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen. Armor cannot reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, and Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on maximum health, so focus on dodging the center instead of only stacking health.
Sett.fight: Avoid the stun angle from Sett E Facebreaker, activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses with a basic attack, then take a short trade. Allow time between the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol, and step back to hit with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and heal. After dealing damage, back off to watch for Sett W Haymaker, then close in again.
Sett.laning: Camille is weak in the first two levels, so focus on CS and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. If Sett is behind minions far from a wall, do not force an engage with Camille E Hookshot. Avoid trading while Camille E Hookshot or Camille P Adaptive Defenses is unavailable.
Sett.combo: Then land a basic attack and both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol, but back off when Sett W Haymaker becomes strong.
Sett.escape: Engage with Camille E Hookshot after Sett E Facebreaker has been used or while Sett R The Show Stopper is unavailable.
Sett.phase: Camille is weakest in the first two levels, so do not rush into a direct trade with Sett. Later, prioritize drawing enemies out in a side lane over taking a direct teamfight.
Sett.teamfight: Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. Avoid positioning with allies on both sides of Sett, where Sett E Facebreaker could stun you together. If the engage angle is poor, do not go in alone first; push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Shen.watch: Dodge Shen E Shadow Dash: if it taunts you, you will be hit by basic attacks empowered by Shen Q Twilight Assault. Also move out of the spirit blade's path back to Shen to reduce the damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, do not use basic attacks empowered by Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity against the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so do not focus on only one type of resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Shen.fight: Look for a chance to engage with Camille E Hookshot right after Shen E Shadow Dash misses. Start the fight with a basic attack on Shen to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses. Land both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol after Shen W Spirit's Refuge ends, allowing time between them to increase the second hit's damage.
Shen.laning: Camille is weak in the first two levels, so focus on CS and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep instead of forcing an early engage. Pushing the wave keeps Shen occupied with CS and makes it harder for him to intervene in another lane with Shen R Stand United. Avoid trading while both Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are unavailable.
Shen.combo: Position Camille W Tactical Sweep so its outer edge hits, securing the slow and healing. To trap an enemy with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, first close the distance with the stun from Camille E Hookshot or the slow from Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Shen.phase: Camille is weakest in the first two levels, so do not rush into a fight; secure CS and lane priority. She reaches her strongest point in the mid game with two core items, and you can look to engage while Shen R Stand United is unavailable.
Shen.teamfight: Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. If the teamfight setup is poor, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your window to engage with Camille E Hookshot. If Shen R Stand United is also on cooldown and has not come back up yet, take advantage of his reduced mobility. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is still available, wait for its zone to end before landing the basic attack empowered by Camille Q Precision Protocol.

Sion.watch: The longer Sion Q Decimating Smash charges, the more dangerous its knockup and stun become, so sidestep when you see him charging it. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught travels in a straight line, so avoid narrow paths and step aside. After killing Sion, reposition to avoid the fast attacks and maximum health damage from Sion P Glory in Death.
Sion.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor if it hits, so dodging it matters even after building defenses.
Sion.fight: Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and use it to heal. Right after Sion W Soul Furnace activates, focus your damage on breaking the shield. Sidestep Sion Q Decimating Smash or force him to release it early, then activate Camille P Adaptive Defenses and space out the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Sion.laning: Camille has weak base stats and waveclear during the first two levels, so focus on CS instead of forcing an early engage. Save Camille E Hookshot when Sion is far from a wall or standing behind minions, and poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. If you keep giving Sion free CS, his maximum health will grow, so disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane.
Sion.escape: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash while it charges or force him to release it early, then close the gap with Camille E Hookshot. Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum to stay on him if needed.
Sion.phase: Camille is weakest during the first two levels, so manage your health with Camille W Tactical Sweep and collect CS early. After unlocking your ultimate, look to join your jungler and follow up on ganks. Once you have two core items in the mid game, look actively for opportunities.
Sion.teamfight: Trap one enemy carry with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, timing it with your team's engage. If engaging alone is difficult, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact charges through terrain and stuns you if he catches you and hits a wall. Keep your back away from walls and move into open space; if you hit a wall, watch for his next charge too. Camille E Hookshot cannot break the suppression from Skarner R Impale, so keep your distance before he catches you.
Skarner.fight: Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is used, close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. Start the fight with a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, and leave time between the two hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. Disengage after trading so you do not keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval.
Skarner.laning: Camille is weak during the first two levels, so collect CS instead of forcing an early engage. Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, and avoid positions where Skarner E Ixtal's Impact can push you into a wall. After using Camille E Hookshot or Camille P Adaptive Defenses, stop trading and wait for your next opportunity.
Skarner.combo: If Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, hit him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then engage with Camille E Hookshot. Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum after the slow from Camille W Tactical Sweep or the stun from Camille E Hookshot holds him in place.
Skarner.escape: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is his only mobility tool, so right after he uses it is your chance to engage with Camille E Hookshot. If Skarner R Impale is still available, account for the fact that Camille E Hookshot cannot break its suppression before going in.
Skarner.phase: Camille is weak during the first two levels, so farm and look for chances to join your jungler to slow Skarner's growth. Camille is strongest in the mid game with two core items, so look for openings when Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down.
Skarner.build: Decide first whether to buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar to deal with Skarner R Impale. Build magic resistance first, taking into account the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval deal damage based on your max health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone.

Teemo.watch: Camille Q Precision Protocol basic attacks also miss while you are affected by Teemo Q Blinding Dart, so stop basic attacking until the blind ends. Avoid trades where you take one basic attack and retreat because of Teemo E Toxic Shot. Watch for hidden Teemo R Noxious Trap mushrooms near objectives and in narrow paths.
Teemo.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap. Choose Ionian Boots of Lucidity for ability haste.
Teemo.fight: Trade right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used. When you can get close, use the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep for its slow and healing. If you have an angle from a wall, use Camille E Hookshot to stun him and close the gap. While his blind is down, basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then land both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Teemo.laning: During the first two levels, collect CS instead of forcing an engage, and wait for an opportunity outside Teemo's range. Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, but save Camille E Hookshot if Teemo is far from a wall or behind minions. Do not approach brush without vision, and pause trading after using Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down and you have an angle from a wall, use Camille E Hookshot to attach to the wall while casting Camille W Tactical Sweep.
Teemo.escape: Your chance to engage comes right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is used. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed, but he has no separate mobility ability. If you have an angle from a wall, close in with Camille E Hookshot and trap him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum if needed.
Teemo.phase: Camille is weakest during the first two levels, so do not force trades while taking Teemo's basic attacks and poison. Camille is strongest in the mid game with two core items, so look to join your jungler and take fights then.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap mushrooms near objectives and in narrow paths before engaging. Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one enemy carry. If the engage looks bad, push a side lane turret to draw the enemy out.

Trundle.watch: When Trundle Q Chomp hits you, it reduces your attack damage, so stop trading until the effect ends. Do not fight on Trundle W Frozen Domain or while Trundle R Subjugate is active; create distance. When Trundle E Pillar of Ice appears, move sideways out of the area before you are slowed.
Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Attack speed reduction is also effective. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on maximum health and steals resistances, so do not rely on stacking health or resistances to survive it; move out of range.
Trundle.fight: Back out of Trundle W Frozen Domain and fight after the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp ends. Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then basic attack Trundle when you close in to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses.
Trundle.combo: Slow Trundle with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then use Camille E Hookshot on a wall to leap to him and stun him.
Trundle.escape: Look to engage after Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and Trundle W Frozen Domain has expired. Check that the attack damage reduction from Trundle Q Chomp and Trundle R Subjugate have also ended. If you have a wall angle, close in with Camille E Hookshot, immobilize him, then trap him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Trundle.phase: Camille is strong in the mid game with two core items, but even late, look for chances to join your team instead of insisting on a side lane duel with Trundle.
Trundle.teamfight: While Trundle R Subjugate is active, create distance or target someone else. Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers.
Trundle.laning: For the first two levels, focus on CS instead of trading with Trundle. Whittle down his health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, but keep it to brief poke and don’t drag out the lane, since Trundle P King’s Tribute can heal him.

Tryndamere.watch: When Tryndamere builds Fury through Tryndamere P Battle Fury, his critical strikes become dangerous, so keep your distance while he attacks minions to build it. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he cannot be killed; buy time with the stun from Camille E Hookshot or create distance. As you retreat, keep facing Tryndamere and walk backward to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.build: Most of Tryndamere's damage is physical and relies on critical strikes, so build armor first. Getting Plated Steelcaps early and following with Randuin's Omen helps in side lane duels alongside the physical shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses.
Tryndamere.fight: When Tryndamere has little Fury, poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses and take a short trade. Once Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, catch him with the stun from Camille E Hookshot and land both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. While Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, wait it out instead of committing more damage.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere to make last hitting difficult, keeping his Fury and healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust low. Camille is weak for the first two levels, so do not force an engage. Chip away at his health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep while taking CS.
Tryndamere.combo: When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, do not rush to deal finishing damage.
Tryndamere.escape: Immediately after forcing Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is a chance to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. Do not start a basic attack fight right after Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, since it reduces your attack damage. If you land the stun from Camille E Hookshot after Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, you can hold him before he moves again.
Tryndamere.phase: Camille is weak for the first two levels, and Tryndamere's critical strikes become dangerous once he builds Fury, so focus on poke and farming early. Camille peaks in the mid game with two core items; look for side lane duels backed by armor items and her shield. Late game, rather than going alone to stop Tryndamere while his R Undying Rage is ready, check whether he has used it and decide how many teammates should respond.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, buy time with the stun from Camille E Hookshot or create distance instead of pouring damage into him. If the teamfight setup is bad, push a side lane tower to draw enemies over.

Udyr.watch: Watch for the stun immediately after Udyr E Blazing Stampede activates. Manage your distance to avoid the empowered basic attacks from Udyr Q Wilding Claw and the slow and maximum health damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Immobilizing effects do not work during the awakened form of Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so do not use the stun from Camille E Hookshot then.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr's main damage. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals mixed damage, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone cannot block everything. Both abilities deal damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Udyr.fight: Burst Udyr after the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle falls, leaving him no time to heal. In close trades, basic attack first to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses, then buy time to land the second hit of Camille Q Precision Protocol. If you have already taken a stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede, use the period when he cannot stun you again to counterattack.
Udyr.laning: Udyr ganks from the jungle, so keep vision on key paths and jungle entrances.
