When his location is unknown, do not push forward; poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and save Camille E Hookshot. Avoid fights and take CS while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are down.
Udyr.combo: Hit with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep first, then attach Camille E Hookshot to a wall and recast it to stun Udyr on collision. To finish him, slow or stun him before trapping him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Udyr.escape: Immediately after forcing Udyr E Blazing Stampede is a chance to close the gap with Camille E Hookshot or Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. However, immobilizing effects do not work during its awakened form, so land the stun from Camille E Hookshot after it ends. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede has already stunned you once, use the period when it cannot stun the same target again.
Udyr.phase: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so prioritize CS and vision over a forced early engage. You can trade with Camille Q Precision Protocol and Camille P Adaptive Defenses; after learning Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, look to join your jungler and follow up on ganks.
Udyr.teamfight: Do not try to burst down Udyr first when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap a vulnerable target in the back, then deal with Udyr once you have a numbers advantage. If the engage setup is bad, push a side lane tower to draw enemies over.

Urgot.watch: Damage from Urgot P Echoing Flames stacks up the longer you stay near him and scales with maximum health, so trade briefly and move out of range. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, it applies a strong slow and marks you as a target for Urgot W Purge, so decide as it flies toward you whether to dodge with Camille E Hookshot. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of its range before you reach the execute threshold.
Urgot.build: Urgot's main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps early for armor. Then consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen, but be careful about stacking health alone because Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with maximum health.
Urgot.fight: Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. When you close in for a short trade, basic attack Urgot first to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses. Move out of range when the trade ends so you do not stay near him and take repeated damage from his leg cannons.
Urgot.laning: Camille is weak for the first two levels, so take CS and chip away at Urgot with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep early. If Urgot is behind minions and far from a wall, farm instead of engaging with Camille E Hookshot. Avoid trades while Camille E Hookshot or Camille P Adaptive Defenses is down, and wait for a chance to join your jungler.
Urgot.combo: Once Urgot E Disdain is down, slow him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then use Camille E Hookshot on a wall to engage and land its collision stun. To finish the kill, slow or stun him before trapping him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility, so engage with Camille E Hookshot just after he misses or uses it. Conversely, when Urgot Q Corrosive Charge flies toward you, decide immediately whether to escape with Camille E Hookshot, since walking out after it hits is difficult.
Urgot.phase: Camille is weakest in the first two levels, and melee champions struggle to face Urgot head-on, so focus on farming. After learning her ultimate, Camille becomes better at joining her jungler and following up on ganks, and she is strongest in the mid game with two core items.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand with your front line to reduce his chances of catching a damage dealer behind them. Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your team's engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers and give your team time to finish them off. If the teamfight setup is bad, push a side lane tower to draw enemies over.

Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash boosts his movement speed to close in, then stuns with an empowered basic attack. Stay outside basic attack range until it expires. When the indicator for Volibear E Sky Splitter appears, move sideways to avoid the damage and slow, and watch where Volibear moves to claim its shield. Avoid fighting when Volibear P The Relentless Storm is stacked, and beware of long trades that give him time to heal with Volibear W Frenzied Maul. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, do not stay under your turret at low health.
Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, Volibear W Frenzied Maul, and Volibear R Stormbringer. If the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul is a problem, buy a healing reduction item. If his basic attacks are strong, also consider reducing his attack speed. Volibear P The Relentless Storm and Volibear E Sky Splitter deal magic damage, so armor alone will not stop them. Since Volibear E Sky Splitter deals damage based on maximum health, avoid stacking only health.
Volibear.fight: After dodging Volibear E Sky Splitter, poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. Fight when the stacks of Volibear P The Relentless Storm have fallen off. Back away if you cannot finish him before he heals with Volibear W Frenzied Maul.
Volibear.laning: Camille is weak at levels one and two, so avoid forcing the first engage. Farm and chip away at his health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. If Volibear approaches with Volibear Q Thundering Smash active, use terrain with Camille E Hookshot or move toward your allies instead of running straight away. Avoid trading while Camille E Hookshot and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are unavailable. Farm when Volibear is far from a wall or standing behind minions.
Volibear.combo: After dodging Volibear E Sky Splitter, slow him with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and land a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses. When you can finish him, trap him with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum after the outer-edge slow from Camille W Tactical Sweep or the stun from Camille E Hookshot.
Volibear.escape: Stay outside basic attack range until Volibear Q Thundering Smash expires, and move out of the strike area of Volibear E Sky Splitter before engaging. The window while Volibear R Stormbringer is unavailable is especially good: close the gap with Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is unavailable, account for his ability to escape with Volibear R Stormbringer.
Volibear.phase: Camille's base stats and wave clear are weak at levels one and two, so do not force a fight with Volibear. Take short trades when Camille Q Precision Protocol and Camille P Adaptive Defenses are ready. After learning your ultimate, look for opportunities to join your jungler and follow up on ganks. Camille is strongest in the mid game with two core items, so take advantage when Volibear R Stormbringer is unavailable.
Volibear.teamfight: Do not fight immediately when Volibear P The Relentless Storm is stacked. Avoid the landing areas of Volibear E Sky Splitter and Volibear R Stormbringer. Time your engage with your allies, approach with Camille E Hookshot, and trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum. If the engage looks poor, push a side lane turret to draw enemies out.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, watch for his whirlwind engage and keep your distance until the stacks expire. When he comes in with Yone E Soul Unbound, hold the stun from Camille E Hookshot to stop his return. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so do not stand alone in the back during teamfights.
Yone.build: For your first core item, consider a Spellblade item such as Trinity Force, whose effect can be applied with both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so do not rely on only one type of resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health; instead of stacking only health, also consider movement speed to leave its telegraphed area.
Yone.fight: Poke and heal with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, and avoid trading blows when Yone's whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready. When you fight, land a basic attack on Yone first to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses. If he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, stun him with the Camille E Hookshot you saved to stop his return, then land both hits of Camille Q Precision Protocol.
Yone.laning: Camille is weak at levels one and two, so do not force an early engage even though Yone is also weak early. Farm while chipping away at his health with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep. When Yone's whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready, stay out of range until the stacks expire. After using Camille E Hookshot or Camille P Adaptive Defenses, avoid trading until it is ready again.
Yone.escape: Do not engage while Yone's whirlwind from Yone Q Mortal Steel is ready; wait for the stacks to expire. If Yone jumps in first with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to stop his return with the stun from Camille E Hookshot. Before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up, close the gap with Camille E Hookshot and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum.
Yone.phase: Yone is weak early, but Camille is also at her weakest in the first two levels. Prioritize farming and poking with Camille W Tactical Sweep. Camille peaks in the mid game with two core items, so look for fights and chances to join your jungler then.
Yone.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so the shield from Yone W Spirit Cleave does not grow larger, and position yourself so Yone R Fate Sealed cannot catch you alone in the back. Save the stun from Camille E Hookshot for Yone's engage with Yone E Soul Unbound to stop his return.

Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and reduces armor, so watch the projectile's path and dodge it. Do not start a fight where many graves have built up, as more Mist Walkers can appear. If Yorick W Dark Procession traps you, cross it with Camille E Hookshot or break the wall by attacking it.
Yorick.build: Build armor first against the damage from Yorick Q Last Rites and his Mist Walkers. Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking only health. If Yorick's basic attacks are a problem, consider an item that reduces attack speed.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, clear the Mist Walkers first if possible, then look for a fight. Camille should trigger Camille P Adaptive Defenses by landing a basic attack on the enemy champion, then trade with Camille Q Precision Protocol. If Yorick W Dark Procession is down, Camille E Hookshot’s stun is a good way to catch him.
Yorick.laning: Camille is weak at levels one and two, so do not force a fight where graves have built up. Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and dodge Yorick E Mourning Mist. Step forward to farm while it is unavailable. Push the lane so Yorick cannot clear the wave and build graves on his side.
Yorick.combo: Slow Yorick with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep, then use Camille E Hookshot to attach to a wall and leap onto him to stun him.
Yorick.escape: Yorick has no mobility ability, so dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist while Yorick W Dark Procession is unavailable gives you an opening to engage. Close the gap and stun him with Camille E Hookshot. Use Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum if you need to keep him trapped.
Yorick.phase: Camille is weak in the first two levels, so farm and avoid fights where there are many graves. Camille peaks in the mid game with two core items. Look for a fight when Yorick's Mist Walkers have been cleared or the Maiden of the Mist is in another side lane.
Yorick.teamfight: Time Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum with your allies' engage to trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers. Engage when your allies can finish that target instead of going in alone first. If a teamfight looks poor, push a side lane turret to draw enemies out. Also look for a trade that secures an objective elsewhere while Yorick pushes a turret alone.

Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, his next cast sends out a whirlwind that knocks enemies up. When you see the stack effect, move sideways out of its path and watch for Yasuo R Last Breath after the knockup. Yasuo can use minions as stepping stones to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.build: Yasuo's main abilities, Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath, deal physical damage, so buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor. Consider Dead Man's Plate or Randuin's Omen afterward. Armor does not stop the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke before committing to a trade. Once the whirlwind from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is unavailable, move sideways as you approach and land a basic attack to activate the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses.
Yasuo.laning: Camille is weak in the first two levels, so focus on farming instead of forcing the first engage. Poke with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep and save Camille E Hookshot. Keeping the wave thin on your side reduces the minions Yasuo can use to approach with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws the whirlwind from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is an opening to engage. Yasuo can use Yasuo E Sweeping Blade again after a short time, so do not chase just because he used it once. Before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up, combine the stun from Camille E Hookshot with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum to close the gap.
Yasuo.phase: Camille is weakest in the first two levels, so focus on farming and poking with the outer edge of Camille W Tactical Sweep early. Look for trades once you can use Camille Q Precision Protocol and the shield from Camille P Adaptive Defenses. After learning your ultimate, look for opportunities to join your jungler and follow up on ganks.
Yasuo.teamfight: Trap one of the enemy's main damage dealers with Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum, timed with your allies' engage. Avoid going in alone first, locking down one target, and dying. If a teamfight looks poor, push a side lane turret to draw enemies out.
